scope: Illustrative diverse consumer sample, NOT an allowlist. Goal is general fixed common hand/slot/body primitives plus domain executors for any Skyrim VR mod.
method: Read-only local archive member/config/PSC inspection and primary public source clones. No closed DLL decompilation, DLL strings, install or game run.
versionPolicy: Archive inputs are latest matching local inputs, not guaranteed latest author releases; source HEADs are not asserted binary-identical to archives.
